recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a non-substantive link repair that completes the current-spec FHIR-7440 reconciliation without needing broader work-group review.
issue_request: FHIR-7440 was a Published / Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the 2015May Extensibility page reporting that a hyperlink pointed to #modifier even though that anchor did not exist; the approved resolution was to fix the broken link.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 1817a6fbe7 / svn r5395, which changed the original in-page source/extensibility.html link from #modifier to #isModifier. The original internal link remains fixed in current source.
additional_context: Current source defines #modifierExtension for the Modifier Extensions section and no #modifier or #modifiers anchor. Active DataTypes, Dosage, Profiling, MarketingStatus, ProductShelfLife, and Version History pages still had cross-page links to the missing anchors. source/fhir.ini and source/hierarchy.xml confirm these pages are current build inputs. Direct Jira search found no more specific related issue, and direct Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Updated all discovered active cross-page links to point to extensibility.html#modifierExtension, preserving the existing wording and changing only link targets.
source_changes: source/datatypes.html: changed Modifier Extensions and Timing modifier-extension links from extensibility.html#modifier to extensibility.html#modifierExtension.
source/dosage.html: changed DosageDetails and Dosage modifier-extension links from extensibility.html#modifier to extensibility.html#modifierExtension.
source/profiling.html: changed modifier-extension guidance link from extensibility.html#modifiers to extensibility.html#modifierExtension.
source/marketingstatus.html: changed the MarketingStatus modifier-extension link from extensibility.html#modifier to extensibility.html#modifierExtension.
source/productshelflife.html: changed the ProductShelfLife modifier-extension link from extensibility.html#modifier to extensibility.html#modifierExtension.
source/history.html: changed the Extensibility diff link for the is-modifier history row from extensibility.html#modifiers to extensibility.html#modifierExtension.

related_jiras.note: Later modifier-rule work established the current Modifier Extensions and isModifier cross-reference structure, making #modifierExtension the appropriate current anchor; it was background only and not decided here.
